text: The calExtract cleanup sets the lazy logger prefix to calendar.calExtract and keeps Warn plus calendar.loglevel. Debug messages no longer repeat the [calExtract] label. Pattern validation and missing-parameter errors still use console.error, so the instance prefix does not prove those global calls carry the same label. Check the actual receiver before treating a prefix cleanup as uniform output behavior.
title: The calExtract logger prefix applies to its instance, while pattern errors still use the global console
